title: SamOliveiraLab/Deepweed: Deepweed
description: Deepweed is a computational framework for automated individual segmentation, temporal tracking, and clonal lineage reconstruction from time-lapse imaging of duckweed (Wolffia australiana), in both free-floating petri dish and microfluidic plant-on-chip culture. It resolves individual fronds rather than population-level biomass, and reconstructs mother-daughter relationships across generations. This release (v1.1.0) is the code state accompanying the revised manuscript BIOINF-2026-0506, submitted to Bioinformatics. Relative to the original submission it adds: retraining of the petri dish U-Net at 512 x 512 input resolution; an independent test set with blank-canvas ground truth and its evaluation script; tracking error metrics (identity switch rate, track fragmentation rate, and per-quarter temporal stability); and rendering of the supplementary videos with post-stitching track labels and correction for global stage displacement. The archive contains the full analysis notebook, the training and evaluation scripts, the independent test set with ground-truth masks, and all three trained model checkpoints. The checkpoints are stored via Git LFS in the GitHub repository and are therefore not contained in GitHub's own release archive; they are included in full here. Source repository: https://github.com/SamOliveiraLab/Deepweed (tag v1.1.0). Imaging data are archived separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18843918
